dashboard.faq_q1: How to transfer Atlas to another Mac?
dashboard.faq_a1: In the 'License Key' block, click 'Transfer to another Mac'. The current Mac will stop working, and you can enter the same key on the new Mac.
dashboard.faq_q2: What if I forgot my key?
dashboard.faq_a2: The key is always here in your dashboard. If the key is compromised — contact support, we will regenerate it.
dashboard.faq_a3: Click 'Cancel auto-renewal' in the Subscription block. Atlas will work until the end date of the current period.
dashboard.faq_q4: Atlas won't launch — what to do?
dashboard.faq_a4: Check that you allowed Accessibility and Microphone in System Settings → Privacy. Restart Atlas. If it doesn't help — write to support.
dashboard.faq_a5: Basic commands work offline. Evolution, new skills, and language models require an internet connection.

final_cta.desc: Join the waitlist first — and be among those who will change the way they interact with macOS.

txt_1002: One word — and the system obeys.
txt_1003: Voice commands, hot actions and contextual understanding of what you need right now.
txt_1008: Atlas freely navigates between applications, performs actions within them and gives you back a focused space.
txt_1010: Checking the status of the camera, managing files, cleaning the trash.
txt_1011: Transparent device control. You always know what's on—and what's off.
txt_1017:
Atlas is not just a chat. It's a true co-pilot for your Mac that
          understands the context and acts exactly when needed.
txt_1019: Direct control of macOS: interaction with active windows (Finder, Safari, Xcode, Terminal) and automation of actions via AppleScript.
txt_1021: A unique cycle of self-improvement: the assistant analyzes its errors, writes new skills, conducts tests and updates its code.
txt_1023: Stores the context of conversations, important facts about the user and builds long-term semantic memory in local JSON.
txt_1025: Independently searches for information on the Internet, aggregates sources, checks facts (fact_checker.py) and prepares analytical reports.
txt_1027: Deep integration with the macOS contact database, reading and writing in Apple Notes, as well as call history analysis.
txt_1029: Monitors the file system, new files, and screen events to offer timely automation of routine tasks.
txt_1031: Determines the mood of the user, analyzes the level of stress, recognizes sarcasm and adjusts the style of responses.
txt_1033: Monitors continuous work time, reminds eye breaks and analyzes sleep schedule according to activity.
txt_1035: Analyzes the interface and content of the user's screen, recognizes active areas and understands the visual context of work.
txt_1037: Protects confidential data, blocks dangerous commands, filters leakage of tokens and passwords, encrypts conversation logs.
txt_1041: Atlas automates your work on the Mac. It interacts with the operating system, manages data and programs, ensuring maximum performance.
txt_1047:
Atlas recognizes you by face, remembers your addresses, preferences and
            names of your guests, ensuring a completely personalized
            experience - no questions asked.
txt_1057: ATLAS is a standalone AI operating system.
txt_1076: Every chat is a blank slate
txt_1083: The only heavy model for everything
txt_1084: Gives data to other people's servers
txt_1087: A cascade of different neural networks
txt_1105: Learn how to configure, activate, and integrate the Atlas Cognitive Operating System into your daily workflow.
txt_1109: The platform consists of two key parts: a local smart client (which runs directly on your macOS system) and a secure cloud sync web interface. This gives you an unprecedented level of speed, security and private control over your data.
txt_1111: Deep semantic memory with a vector database to store the user's interests, schedule and preferences.
txt_1113: Background autonomous agents are capable of conducting deep Internet research and planning complex task chains.
txt_1116: At the first launch, ATLAS gets to know the user. It scans your face through a webcam and creates a 512-dimensional vector (Embedding) that is stored purely locally. Thanks to this, ATLAS instantly recognizes you when you sit down at the computer, without sending photos to the cloud.
txt_1118: (Voice Activity Detection) to detect speech. This allows him to "listen" without reacting to background noise or his own voice (echo cancellation).
txt_1119: The system has built-in cascade routing (Routing). Processing priorities are divided into:
txt_1120: (quick dialogues through economical models like DeepSeek),
txt_1121: (complex planning through Gemini or Claude), and
txt_1122: (writing code to expand your own skills).
txt_1123: ATLAS recognizes not only the Owner, but also remembers the "Guests". Thanks to the local vision system, it understands who is in front of the screen, giving guests individual access rights or appropriate treatment during the conversation.
txt_1124: All important information from your conversations is stored in a local vector database. ATLAS quickly searches for facts so as not to "forget" the context even months after the previous communication.
txt_1125: Your assistant is not tied to a computer. Thanks to the built-in bridge, you can communicate with ATLAS via Telegram when you're on the go. It remembers the same context, uses the same skills, and can control your Mac remotely.
txt_1126: ATLAS "sees" the screen. Based on a multimodal model, it analyzes open applications, graphics and interfaces, helping you in the context of what you're currently looking at.
txt_1127: Delegate the routine. You can give ATLAS the task "Find all information about X, analyze and report". It will create background agents, analyze dozens of sources and send you the finished result in Telegram.
txt_1129: filters sensitive information on the fly. Your passwords, personal data and keys will never get into cloud neural network queries.

txt_1198: At Atlas AI, we put your privacy first. This Privacy Policy describes how our applications and services interact with your data. Our fundamental principle: **your data belongs only to you**.
txt_1201: We store your email, name and password (encrypted via SHA-256) solely for the purpose of managing your account and activating your license key.
txt_1203: All audio recordings (voice recognition via the Vosk model) and screen analysis are processed locally on your computer. We never transfer your voice recordings to our servers.
txt_1205: During license verification, the system transmits a unique computer identifier (Mac ID) and device name to limit the use of the key on multiple Macs at the same time.
txt_1207: The Atlas AI app interacts with Google Gemini and OpenAI artificial intelligence services to process user text queries. These requests are sent directly through the personal API keys you specified in the settings or through a secure proxy of the license server.
txt_1209: All data is transmitted using the encrypted HTTPS protocol. Passwords are stored in the database using one-way SHA-256 cryptographic hashing and random salt. Access to the personal account is protected by session httpOnly cookies.
txt_1211: You have every right to request the removal of your account and all associated license keys from our database at any time. To do this, contact our support bot in Telegram (
txt_1212: ) or send a request to the mail indicated in the contacts.
txt_1216: Welcome to Atlas AI. Please read the Terms of Use carefully before using our software and licensing services.

txt_1221: Copying, reselling, renting or distributing license keys to third parties is strictly prohibited. If suspicious activity is detected, the license is automatically blocked without the right to refund.
txt_1223: If you change your Mac ID, you can independently untie the key from the old device in the user's personal account and bind it to the new computer.
txt_1225: We regularly release security updates, new versions of speech models and additional modules (Skills). Lifetime license keys receive all future updates for free. Recurring subscriptions are valid for the paid billing period.
txt_1227: We are confident in the quality of Atlas AI and offer users a free trial key or demo mode. A refund request can be made within 14 calendar days of purchasing a paid license if the software is not compatible with your system configuration.
txt_1229: Atlas AI is provided on an "as is" basis. We are not responsible for direct or indirect damages, loss of data or performance of third-party API services (Gemini/OpenAI/Telegram) integrated by the user in their local application.
